question: Who among the following was the co-winner of Bharat Ratna with Lata Mangeskar in the year 2001?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bismillah Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bismillah Khan** was a legendary Indian musician who played the shehnai.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **2001**.
 
• Khan was born on** March 21, 1916**, in Dumraon, Bihar, and he belonged to a family of musicians.
 
• He is credited with elevating the shehnai, a traditional folk instrument, to the status of a classical concert instrument.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna**

 
 
• The Bharat Ratna is the** highest civilian award** of the Republic of India.
 
• It was instituted in 1954 by the then President of India, Rajendra Prasad.
 
• The award is given for exceptional service towards the advancement of Art, Literature and Science, and in recognition of Public Service of the highest order.
 
• It is awarded without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
 
 
• **Shehnai**
 
 
• The shehnai is a traditional **Indian musical instrument** made of wood with a double reed at one end and a metal or wooden flared bell at the other end.
 
• It is usually played in traditional North Indian weddings and religious ceremonies.
 
• Bismillah Khan is one of the most well-known shehnai players in the world, and he has played an instrumental role in popularizing the instrument.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Bharat Ratna Awardees**
 
 
• **Mother Teresa** - Awarded in **1980 **for her humanitarian work and founding the Missionaries of Charity in Kolkata.
 
• **Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam** - Awarded in **1997 **for his work in science and as a key figure in India's space and missile programs.
 
• **Nelson Mandela** - Awarded in **1990 **for his struggle against apartheid and his role in promoting peace and reconciliation.
